title: Kiosk Checkout, Kits and Interruptions
eyebrow: WisconsinKiosk · redesign D3, E1–E3, I1, I3, I4, J4
lede: Picking another date uses a month grid, kits become the checkout's checklist for football crew and ask before leaving items behind, discarding scans is a card instead of a system dialog, and the interruptions (sleeping scanner, Still here?) read as the canvas does. Sounds for each moment follow J4.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Before is HEAD 4b26cccb built into a separate derived-data path; after is f84a0c5d plus the second commit's working patch. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 26.5, dark, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures.

pairs.title: Scan step (no kit for non-football crew)
pairs.beforeCap: The kit menu showed for everyone.
pairs.afterCap: The kit row only shows for football crew (server suggestion or a football shift); this fixture has neither.

pairs.title: Scan accepted
pairs.afterCap: Unchanged layout; the accept chime now plays with it (not capturable).

pairs.title: I4 still here? on the hub
pairs.beforeCap: Clock icon, a draining bar, Keep going / I'm done.
pairs.afterCap: Countdown ring, Still here, Erik?, I'm done for now / I'm here.

sections.heading: After only (states the old build can't open)
sections.note: These need fixtures added in this slice, or the old UI was a system control no fixture could open.

shots.title: D3 other date
shots.cap: Month grid (past days dimmed, today ringed, Oct 1 labelled) with 4-column time chips and a Back by summary. Before: the native graphical DatePicker (no fixture could open it).

shots.title: I1 discard scans
shots.cap: A card with Keep scanning and a red Discard that names the tags. Before: a system confirmation dialog.

shots.title: E1 choose a kit
shots.cap: Shift and the suggested kit's contents on the left; kits on the right with SUGGESTED. Before: a pull-down menu.

shots.title: E2 scanning against a kit
shots.cap: Taking out is the kit's checklist in kit order, "4 of 7 + 1 extra", LENS-12 marked Not in kit; the confirmation names what is still to scan.

shots.title: E3 asks first
shots.cap: Check out with three kit items unscanned swaps the stage for an amber card with Keep scanning / Check out without them.

shots.title: I3 scanner asleep
shots.cap: A grey pill in place of the scan target: "Scanner is asleep. Press its trigger to wake it." Before: the same words in amber under the target.

shots.title: I4 still here?
shots.cap: Countdown ring, "Still here, Erik?", "your 4 scans wait 20 minutes" (KioskStore.cartRetention), I'm done for now / I'm here.

changes.was: A native graphical DatePicker in the sheet's left panel.
changes.now: A month grid with 52pt round day cells and 4-column time chips; Use this date stays disabled for a past time.

changes.was: A system confirmation dialog, plus a second dialog before Edit.
changes.now: A 540pt card with a red Discard naming the tags; the hidden scanner field disarms under it. Edit goes straight to details (scans stay). Pickup and return have no discard: their scans commit as they happen.

changes.was: A pull-down kit menu for everyone; remaining kit items listed after the scans; checkout went through with kit items unscanned.
changes.now: Football crew only; a two-panel chooser; the kit is the checklist; an amber card asks before checking out without kit items. Labels are the kit's own name.

changes.was: Amber text under the scan target.
changes.now: A grey pill replaces the target on checkout, pickup, and return.
Ring with seconds, the person's first name, and the real 20-minute retention in the copy; two pings when it appears.

changes.was: Only a rejection tone; Reduce Motion removed some animations outright.
changes.now: KioskFeedbackSound accept / reject / undo / done / badge / attention / warning, each tied to a visible twin; Reduce Motion movements are 150 ms fades (button press scale stays off).

npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- tests/ios-system-quality-contract.test.ts tests/ios-api-contract.test.ts: 23 files, 121 tests passed
notes: Sound is unverified: simulator captures are silent, and the fleet iPads need an on-device listen for level against the scanner beep.
Kit availability (Out with…, Reserved for…) is dropped: kiosk/kits has no status field (class b).
The football-crew gate is a heuristic (server kit suggestion or an FB shift); there is no crew field on the kiosk user.
